scope: Published employer HTML under /careers/; excludes the customer-facing /jobs/ marketplace. No application requests.
review: The listing client filters only the existing DOM job rows; all three select defaults are all. The role client adjusts layout and submits the same native form role/slug/page only after user submission; no additional criteria are fetched. Base client changes navigation, decorative waves, slideshows and videos. Stylesheets leave the job-row, jr-title, jr-meta and jr-block criteria visible; responsive rules hide decorative jr-band only. All source criteria are retained without generated headings.
